name: ClawHub Chat Channel
description: Managed-instance channel for ClawHub. ClawHub forwards in-page chat messages to the QwenPaw container and streams runner events back.

config_fields.name: enabled
config_fields.description: Enable the channel in the channel manager. The HTTP route is registered when the custom channel is installed.

config_fields.name: token
config_fields.description: Optional shared secret. When set, ClawHub must send it as X-ClawHub-Token.
